 Nevertheless, Real Madrid have won this streak before, and their current momentum could make them more competitive than in previous instances.
 The key tactical point
 For Barcelona, ​​the most important factor is their reaction to their recent defeat. Playing at home, along with their position at the top of the table, gives them a good psychological foundation to regain their stability.
 Real Madrid have a clear motivation: to maintain their winning streak and directly challenge the league leaders. A good result at Camp Nou would further boost the visitors' confidence in the race.
 Since both teams are vying for the top spot, every small mistake can be punished. The team that controls the pace well and minimizes its own errors will have a greater advantage.
 Assessment
 Overall, Barcelona has the advantage in terms of league position, head-to-head record, and home advantage. However, Real Madrid is in better form at the moment with a streak of four consecutive wins.
